title: Prove first-range BIT caller numerical capacity prefixes
body:
PR2825's numerical envelope assumed successful `Consumer.apply` execution; PR2835 removed that premise only for closed coefficient calls. This package proves the remaining non-coefficient allocation-prefix effects for unchanged PR2697 and composes them with PR2835. With all entry live residents L and allocated backing K counted, capacities `C_R >= max(K_R,L_R+37672)` and `C_I >= max(K_I,L_I+41)` exclude a first numerical inventory failure. Setup's transient nine indices and the fallback child's retained zero half-width Word remain explicitly charged.

The result is a **conditional all-parameter written source proof** for dimension 64, widths 64–127, ranks 1–42 and admitted finite programs/fields. Semantic validity/termination, PR2835's closed-coefficient prefix/restoration contracts, distinct canonical arenas and numerical-neutral external providers remain premises. This is not selected catalogue admission, a physical/recursive/outer reserve, a formal-kernel proof or a new kappa.

Only `research/selected-caller-capacity-prefix/` is added at `e053f223c5e225554130572b1af4f329068ec7aa`. Frozen PR2825 source/harness and PR2831/2835 proof exports retain exact pins and notices. Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, Nick Petalas, Arham Tahir, Ross Richardson, David Arias, ywz65, starship-s and retained source lineage. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance includes a separate mathematical AI audit; no independent human review is claimed.
